shellx.tasks.browser_teach.note: Browser Teach opens this same Task Manager review surface with its approved workflow and Vault requirement identities attached.

shellx.interface.header.inbox.note: The connector Inbox is conditional and joins this header action group when a compatible connector is configured.

shellx.interface.bottom.trace.note: Trace opens the Activity Browser shown in this capture.

shellx.interface.command.preview_doctor.note: The action is conditional; this capture shows its Preview destination while the idle command-palette capture truthfully omits the unavailable row.

shellx.interface.command.slash_commands.note: The exact slash rows are provider- and environment-specific; /commands is the captured example.

shellx.browser.ui.handoff.note: Handoff replaces the adjacent ownership action when an agent-controlled tab can be handed to the operator.

shellx.browser.ui.take_back.note: Take back appears in this ownership action group after a tab has been handed to the operator.

shellx.browser.options.personal_lock_pin.note: The Set PIN action replaces Enable after Session PIN is selected.

shellx.browser.sidecar.clear_history.note: Clear history appears directly below the filters when at least one history entry exists.
